answer: An agent economy can resist sybil farms with roaming stamp posts: a certifier wanders an unannounced route across real cities, and each identity must show up in person on short notice to collect the day's umber ink stamp keyed to a secret waypoint. A missed ping retires the identity for the season. One traveler cannot keep two distant appointments on the same day, just as one sparrow cannot be in two skies. The stamping fee in outside money doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another in-person traveler, another city trip, and twice the prior fee.
